guidebook.intro: Emergencies. Short commands save time: **Ko ma!** (help me!), **Ure!** (hurry!).

tips.title: Ko ma!
body: **Ko ma!** help me, **Oguli!** thief, **Omvi polisi!** call the police, **Aci!** fire.
**Oguli ji ma simu ra** (a thief took my phone).

tips.title: Ze ra
body: **Agupi ze ra** (the man is hurt), **Ari fu eri ni** (blood comes out of him). **Ama omvi ambulensi ure!**
**Mi muke ya?** — **Ii, ma muke.** **E’yo ovu ku** (no problem).

culture.title: Emergency numbers
body: In Uganda, 999 and 112 reach the police; neighbours are usually the first to help.
